MINUTES 11-9-17
MINUTES 11-9-17
CITY HALL COUNCIL CHAMBER
38300 SIERRA HIGHWAY, SUITE B
PALMDALE, CALIFORNIA
Thursday NOVEMBER 9, 2017
07:00 P.M.
www.cityofpalmdale.org
WELCOME
NOTICE: This meeting will be simulcast live on Time Warner Channel 27 and at www.cityofpalmdale.org.
PLEASE NOTE:
For record keeping purposes, if you wish to make a statement regarding any item on the agenda, please complete the Speaker Slip located on the side table and deposit it with the Deputy City Clerk. (Note: There is a three-minute time limit per speaker imposed. Please stay within this limit.)
In accordance with the Americans with Disabilities Act of 1990, if you require a disability-related modification or accommodation to attend or participate in this meeting, including auxiliary aids or services, please call the Planning Division at 661/267 5200 at least 48 hours prior to the meeting.
Your courtesy is requested to help our meeting run smoothly. If you'll be kind enough to follow these simple rules, we can make the best possible use of your time and ours:
If you wish to speak on an item, please fill out a Speaker's Slip and deliver it to the Deputy City Clerk BEFORE the item is discussed.
Please refrain from public displays or outbursts such as unsolicited applause, comments or cheering.
Any disruptive activities that substantially interfere with the ability of the Planning Commission to carry out its meeting will not be permitted and offenders will be requested to leave the meeting.
Please turn off cell phones and electronic devices.
1. Call to Order
2. Pledge of Allegiance to the Flag
3. Roll Call: Chair Nemeth Vice Chair French
Commissioner Aleman, Avery, and Ward
4. Review of Agenda
5. Motion to Waive Full Reading of all Resolutions on the Agenda for this Meeting
6. Public Comments on Consent Calendar Items and any Items not on the Agenda
7. Consent Calendar Approval of Minutes from the Regular Planning Commission Meeting of October 12, 2017
7
8. Public Hearings
8A. General Plan Amendment 17-002/Zone Change 17-017
Dr. Laura Herman of Palmdale Aerospace Academy, Applicant
A request to amend the General Plan Land Use Designation from MFR (Multi-Family Residential) to PF (Public Facility) and to change the zone designation from R-3 (Multiple Residential) to PF (Public Facility) on approximately 16 acres located at 3300 East Palmdale Boulevard (Aerospace Academy).
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-041 recommending the City Council approve General Plan Amendment 17-002 and Zone Change 17-017, and recommend that the City Council find that the project will not result in any changes to the previously adopted Mitigated Negative Declaration and the Mitigation Monitoring Program. Carlene Saxton, Senior Planner
8A
8B. Tentative Tract Map 54209 Time Extension 2
Ms. Corinna Ocampo, Applicant
A request for a three-year time extension for the subdivision of approximately 27 acres into 95 Single-Family Residential Lots and two detention basin lots located at the northeast corner of Avenue R and 35th Street East
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-040 approving Tentative Tract Map 54209 Time Extension 2 and find that the project will not result in any changes to the Mitigated Negative Declaration adopted for Tentative Map 54209 on July 15, 2004. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8B
8C. Conditional Use Permit (CUP) 17-009
Mr. David Chang, Applicant
A request to establish a Type 47 (On-Sale General) Alcoholic Beverage Control License for a bona fide restaurant (Hooter's) located at 39224 10th Street West
Staff Recommendation: It is recommended that the Planning Commission adopt Resolution No. PC-2017-038 approving alcoholic beverage sales (Type 47, On-Sale General) within a bona fide restaurant (Hooter's), and find that the project is Categorically Exempt from environmental review. Megan Taggart, Senior Planner
8C
9. Staff Communications
9A. Training on Alcohol Beverage Establishments
Noel Doran, Assistant City Attorney
9B. Development Update
Rob Bruce, Planning Manager
10. Planning Commission Communications
